public.text: Foundational data exchange is described as neutral transport, while health-specific mediation is located at endpoints. In practice, foundational exchange platforms may provide routing, authentication, audit, policy enforcement, eventing, and service discovery beyond basic transport.
public.suggestedRevision: Define a capability boundary rather than assuming a narrow foundational platform. Countries should map the capabilities already provided by foundational DPI and implement only the additional health-specific semantic, clinical, consent, and workflow capabilities required.
